chunks: With this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad and Aḥmad, from their father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from some of our companions, from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
When the blood has ceased and she has not performed ghusl, then her husband may approach her, if he wishes.
ai.seo_question: Can a husband approach his wife after menstrual bleeding stops but before she performs ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman after the cessation of menstrual blood. It states that once the bleeding has stopped, the husband may approach her even if she has not yet performed ghusl.
